mechanism_narrative: EGFR-FGFR4 forced proximity with a flexible GS4 linker (~20 Å) creates a co-clustered signaling complex with ~270 aa ECD asymmetry (EGFR ECD=645 aa, FGFR4 ECD=375 aa). This geometry enables transphosphorylation where EGFR kinase phosphorylates FGFR4 juxtamembrane tyrosines (creating FRS2 docking sites) and FGFR4 kinase reciprocally phosphorylates EGFR tyrosines (Y1068, Y1086, Y1173, creating GRB2/SHC1/GAB1 docking sites). The shared transphosphorylation signalosome (GRB2-SHC1-SOS1→RAS→RAF→MEK→ERK and FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1→PI3K→AKT→mTOR) is synergistically activated. PLCG1 is sterically excluded from the tilted EGFR-FGFR4 interface, suppressing the PLCγ/Ca²⁺/PKC branch. This biased output (MAPK↑, AKT↑, PLCγ↓) promotes muscle structural gene expression and suppresses aged inflammatory/senescence markers, consistent with a rejuvenating transcriptional shift.
